_status: approved by Alan Mössinger as drafted, 2026-10-22

paraphrases.original: We will not accept more than a ten percent chance of losing money on the book.
paraphrases.paraphrase: A chance of losing money above one in ten is more than this committee will carry.

paraphrases.original: Our lenders cap the average loss in the worst five percent of outcomes at 750 million dollars.
paraphrases.paraphrase: The banks limit our average loss in the worst five percent of cases to 750 million dollars.

paraphrases.original: No gas, full stop.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Gas is out, without exception.

paraphrases.original: We can find 1.5 billion dollars beyond the reserve for construction.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Beyond the reserve we can put 1.5 billion dollars into construction if it is called.

paraphrases.original: Commit at least ninety percent of the budget.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Ninety percent of the budget, at least, has to be committed.

paraphrases.original: A one-in-twenty chance of a loss is our ceiling.
paraphrases.paraphrase: We draw the line at a five percent chance of a loss.

paraphrases.original: Keep storage out of the book, and the worst-five-percent average loss under 600 million.
paraphrases.paraphrase: No storage in the book, and keep the worst-five-percent average loss below 600 million.

paraphrases.original: A dollar lost in the worst five percent of outcomes counts twice as much to us as a dollar of expected value.
paraphrases.paraphrase: To us a dollar lost in the worst five percent weighs as much as two dollars of expected value.

paraphrases.original: Only expected value matters to this committee; we are risk-neutral.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Risk does not enter it: we want the highest expected value, nothing else.

paraphrases.original: We will not fund the 1,350 MW gas request, REQ|ERCOT|25INR0008.
paraphrases.paraphrase: The gas request REQ|ERCOT|25INR0008, the 1,350 MW one, is not to be funded.

paraphrases.original: No solar and no storage.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Neither solar nor storage.

paraphrases.original: Our credit line for construction beyond the reserve is one billion dollars.
paraphrases.paraphrase: For construction beyond the reserve we hold a credit line of one billion dollars.

paraphrases.original: We want at most an eight percent chance of losing money, and at least eighty percent of the budget committed.
paraphrases.paraphrase: At most an eight percent chance of a loss, and no less than eighty percent of the budget put to work.

paraphrases.original: Treat a dollar of tail loss as half a dollar of value.
paraphrases.paraphrase: A dollar of loss in the tail is worth half a dollar of value to us.

paraphrases.original: The worst five percent of outcomes may not cost us more than 1.2 billion dollars on average.
paraphrases.paraphrase: On average, the worst five percent of outcomes must cost us no more than 1.2 billion dollars.

paraphrases.original: We do not do wind.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Wind is not something we invest in.

paraphrases.original: Leave out the Gulf leases altogether.
paraphrases.paraphrase: The Gulf leases are out of the book entirely.

paraphrases.original: We can raise 500 million dollars for construction calls beyond what we reserve now, no more.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Five hundred million dollars is all we can raise for construction calls beyond the reserve.

paraphrases.original: Spend at least three quarters of the budget.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Commit no less than seventy-five percent of the budget.

paraphrases.original: Our board accepts a chance of loss of up to fifteen percent.
paraphrases.paraphrase: A fifteen percent chance of losing money is acceptable to the board, no more.

paraphrases.original: Exclude the 836 MW wind request REQ|ERCOT|26INR0113 and the 1,026 MW solar request REQ|ERCOT|26INR0155.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Leave out REQ|ERCOT|26INR0113 (the 836 MW wind request) and REQ|ERCOT|26INR0155 (the 1,026 MW solar request).

paraphrases.original: We weigh losses in the worst five percent four times as heavily as expected value.
paraphrases.paraphrase: A dollar of loss in the worst five percent counts four times a dollar of expected value.

paraphrases.original: Batteries are out, and the average loss in the worst five percent must stay below 900 million.
paraphrases.paraphrase: No batteries, and the worst-five-percent average loss under 900 million.

paraphrases.original: Two billion dollars is available for construction beyond the reserve.
paraphrases.paraphrase: We have two billion dollars for construction calls beyond the reserve.

paraphrases.original: A chance of losing money above six percent is unacceptable.
paraphrases.paraphrase: We will not accept a chance of loss above six percent.

paraphrases.original: No new gas plants, and at most a twelve percent chance of a loss.
paraphrases.paraphrase: No gas plants, and a chance of loss of twelve percent at most.

paraphrases.original: Put at least sixty percent of the budget to work.
paraphrases.paraphrase: At least sixty percent of the budget must be spent.

paraphrases.original: Our worst-five-percent average loss limit is 450 million dollars.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Our ceiling on the worst-five-percent average loss is 450 million dollars.

paraphrases.original: We count expected value and tail loss one for one.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Expected value and tail loss count the same, dollar for dollar.

paraphrases.original: No solar requests, and we can call 800 million dollars beyond the reserve for construction.
paraphrases.paraphrase: No solar, and 800 million dollars available beyond the reserve for construction.

paraphrases.original: Exclude the lease G14658.
paraphrases.paraphrase: The lease LEASE|G14658 is excluded.

paraphrases.original: Risk-neutral, and no storage.
paraphrases.paraphrase: We are risk-neutral and we hold no storage.

paraphrases.original: Interest rates will rise two points; choose the book that survives that.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Rates are going up by two points; pick what still stands after that.

paraphrases.original: Price carbon at 80 dollars a tonne in every project.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Charge every project 80 dollars a tonne for its carbon.

paraphrases.original: Every project must clear an internal rate of return of twelve percent.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Nothing below a twelve percent internal rate of return gets funded.

paraphrases.original: Only fund projects with an ESG rating of A or better.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Fund only what carries an ESG rating of A or above.

paraphrases.original: Hedge the oil exposure with futures before committing.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Before we commit, hedge the oil exposure in the futures market.

paraphrases.original: Assume inflation runs at five percent a year.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Build in five percent inflation a year.

paraphrases.original: Prefer projects that a partner would co-invest in.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Give preference to projects a partner would co-invest in.

paraphrases.original: Include hydrogen projects in the book.
paraphrases.paraphrase: Put hydrogen projects into the book.
